title: Durable Task Record
description: Represents a durable task record in the Apex AI DPT framework.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the task.

dependencies.description: List of task IDs this task depends on.

required_capabilities.description: Capabilities required to execute this task.

denied_capabilities.description: Capabilities explicitly denied for this task.

human_gate_state.description: Current state of human approval gates.

passport_revision.description: Revision of the associated task passport.

canonical_artifact.description: Reference to the canonical artifact for this task.

state_revision.description: Revision number of the task state.

next_task.description: ID of the next task in the workflow.

auto_continue.description: Whether the task should auto-continue to the next task.
